constraints: This document specifies future Worker implementation. Current RESEARCH_SA edits only plan/routing and runs labelled prototypes; exact independent READY plus all direct dependencies DONE are mandatory before Worker source changes.
Generic command checks and injected verifiers already exist. Package the named local profile without replacing product authority or claiming generic checks are incapable of browser/API testing.
Repository metadata and primary reports motivate prototypes; no benchmark score, saved effort or new capability is claimed from a source survey.
Public OSS examples require at least 1000 GitHub stars at lookup. Pin release/source, inspect relevant implementation/tests and reproduce the seam before adoption.
Keep the two Blackboard boundaries distinct: this graph routes ExHarness development; new profiles execute within the product/runtime boundary.

architectureDecisions: D1: Select NODE_HTTP_SQLITE_LOCAL_V1: trusted local loopback HTTP service, Node major24/Linux x64 with built-in SQLite (calibrated24.20.0/3.53.4) and an owned file-backed SQLite fixture. A finite externally pinned previous-client request/assertion manifest plus independent row assertions verifies one explicit forward migration and a fresh process restart; no inferred migration or generic OpenAPI compatibility claim.

D2: Implement createApiStateVerifier as the existing Product QA criterionVerifier injection. Resolve an external protected profile by snapshotRef/verifierPolicyRef, validate all input digests before effects and emit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE plus content-addressed evidenceRefs. Product QA observes runtime identity, aggregates criteria and owns QualityAcceptance publication unchanged.

D3: Implement the plan-owned preview/protected input adapters with profileContract interfaces inside api-state-verifier.js. Every direct dependency must be DONE before Worker. They supply delivered owned startup/receipt/dispose and protected input pins; this task supplies the SQLite migration/restart lifecycle. No alternate implementation before dependency DONE, and no unresolved API selection.

D4: Do not adopt Schemathesis/Testcontainers. Inspected pinned source/tests support optional future adapters; Node avoids Python/container prerequisites. No external runtime or comparative cost/value claim.
D5: Expose a callable factory via Product QA injection; no deliver manifest/CLI extension. Generic command checks remain usable. BB-071/074 own change/value and BB-129 owns handoff.
D6: Keep DRAFT; only fresh independent Jev SATISFIED grants readiness. Calibration establishes prototype feasibility, not product implementation, dependency delivery or value.

D7 — Map each fault to exact verdict/reason and effect boundary in testContract. Focused tests directly exercise the new factory and Product QA injection; generic QA tests cannot stand in for adapter evidence. Retain deterministic single-request/single-seed-row reproducers for observed compatibility failures and bounded setup diagnostics for inconclusive failures.
implementationSlices: S1 — After dependencies DONE/fresh READY, implement factory, config/digest/criterion validation and snapshot-to-protected-profile resolver. Bind preview and ownership before effects. Validate exact own-key schemas and immutable byte hashes from profileContract; implement the plan-owned previewLifecycle adapter rather than assuming new exports from BB-131. Separate preview readiness from independent Product QA identities. Capture store realpath/ownership token once and reject foreign or symlink roots before migration/disposal. Public createApiStateVerifier({resolvePinnedInput,previewLifecycle,evidenceStore,now}) returns verify({snapshotRef,environmentRef,components,criterionRef,verifierPolicyRef}). Resolver pins exact Git candidate/tree/config, independent QA release/snapshot/environment, preview receipt and external priorClient/business/evaluator/seed/migration file refs+hashes. Profile supports Node24/Linuxx64 node:sqlite DatabaseSync only; no dynamic schema oracle. Private lifecycle prepareOwned/startBaseline/migrateOnce/startCandidate/restartCandidate/observeStore/dispose uses BB-131 startup/readiness/ownership without its reseeding reset. Runtime/version/binary and pinned bytes rechecked before effects and after phases.

S2 — Verify baseline client/seed, execute candidate forward migration, old-client/new-feature assertions and restart a fresh process on the same store. Record old/new row/schema facts, enforce budgets and dispose only owned resources. Fixed oracle: seed row1 legacy/open, schema v1; forward migration adds non-null priority default0 v2 without dropping old fields/rows; prior client creates/reads row2; new client row3 priority2 updates title. Stop and reap candidate, restart on identical owned DB without reset/reseed, then reread rows and required schema. Protected prior client/business assertions determine expected values, never candidate schema. Record each mandatory assertion id and exact bounded request/response.

S3 — Emit content-addressed criterion observations/reproducers with all identities through existing Product QA. Test actual factory injection, every named negative and complete positive flow. Adapter cannot publish acceptance. Implement deterministic first-failure reproducer reduction: keep only declared fixed seed row and one failing request/expected/actual, with pinned migration/client/evaluator refs; replay it in fresh owned fixture and require the same violation before retaining its digest. If reproduction/setup fails, retain full bounded case with explicit NOT_MINIMIZED; never claim successful reduction. Focused tests verify reduced data-loss and schema cases plus actual factory injection into Product QA with independent runtimeObserver. Return {verdict,evidenceRefs}; evidenceStore.put stores immutable API_STATE_CRITERION_EVIDENCE with exact criterion/QA/candidate/schema/data/evaluator/preview bindings and executed assertion IDs. FAIL means observed protected behavioral mismatch; setup/parse/timeout/missing identities/coverage/digest drift INCONCLUSIVE. PASS only after all required assertions, unchanged protected bytes, durable evidence and owned cleanup. Limits20requests/1s each, startup/migration/stop2s, total30s, response8KiB/evidence64KiB. Retain first mismatch before cleanup; evidenceStore or cleanup failure prevents PASS. Adapter has no acceptance publisher; actual ProductQA injection and runtimeObserver independently govern publication.

S4 — Run declared focused/QA/regression/docs checks under Node24/Linux x64, retain exact bound Worker evidence and update Living limits. Before execution ensure dependencies DONE and delivered APIs match the explicit projections. Any mismatch invalidates READY and returns to research; no implementation authority follows from a shim or prototype.

profileContract.support: Trusted local Node major24/Linux x64 with built-in node:sqlite DatabaseSync; loopback HTTP, one owned DB file/forward migration. Observed calibration was Node24.20.0/SQLite3.53.4; preserve those measured facts, with no cross-version equivalence claim. Every supplied runtime is independently pinned by version/binary hash and checked by focused API/SQLite fixtures. Unsupported/missing runtime is INCONCLUSIVE. profileContract.factory: createApiStateVerifier({ resolvePinnedInput, previewLifecycle, evidenceStore, now }) => { verify({ snapshotRef, environmentRef, components, criterionRef, verifierPolicyRef }) => Promise<{ verdict, evidenceRefs }> }
profileContract.resolver: resolvePinnedInput receives the QA verify request and returns immutable protected profileRef/hash, 40-hex Git candidateSha, checkout tree/config digest, previewReceiptRef/hash, environment/snapshot/release, evaluator/priorClient/businessAssertions/seed/migration refs+hashes, schema versions, criterionBindings and bounded commands. Hash actual bytes/canonical config. Criterion must belong to snapshot and every mandatory assertion must execute.
profileContract.previewShim: Plan-owned fixture lifecycle implemented in api-state-verifier.js using injected previewLifecycle; not an existing BB-131 export. Implement prepareOwned/startBaseline/migrateOnce/startCandidate/restartCandidate/observeStore/dispose over tracked fixture scripts and a single privately owned store root. BB-131 startLocalPreview supplies owned service startup/readiness/receipt/dispose only. Its reset creates a new seeded generation, so never call reset between migration and restart. Restart must stop/reap owned candidate process then start again against exactly the same DB path, seed generation and protected migration history. Every fixture service receipt binds candidate/tree/runtime/config; QA snapshot/environment/release stay independent. Resolve scripts/runtime/env from operator-pinned profile before effects; no inferred commands.
profileContract.protectedInputs: BB-127 pins external evaluator/client/business assertions outside candidate write scope; resolve by snapshot/policy. Candidate schema is diagnostic only. Rehash inputs/preview before effects, after migration/restart and before final evidence. Digest drift/missing identity fails closed. Trusted local commands are unsandboxed.
profileContract.fixture: Version 1 tasks(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,title/status required TEXT), seed id1/legacy/open. Migration adds priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version 2. Assert old row/priority0; prior client creates id2; new client id3/priority2 updates title, rejects missing title and persists after restart. Seed digest binds inputs, not unchanged whole DB bytes.
profileContract.budgets: Default maximum 20 requests, 1000ms per HTTP request, 2000ms startup/readiness/migration/stop, 30000ms total run, 8192 bytes each response/diagnostic, 65536 bytes total evidence. Finite request sequence and fixed seed, no randomized generation. Abort/kill only owned children, close connections before reset, return INCONCLUSIVE on exhaustion with mandatory observations absent. Retain content-addressed sanitized evidence before cleanup.
profileContract.result: evidenceStore.put(envelope) returns immutable evidenceRef. API_STATE_CRITERION_EVIDENCE/version 1 binds criterionRef/verdict/reason, candidateSha/tree/config, snapshot/environment/release, preview/evaluator/priorClient/businessAssertions/seed/migration refs+hashes, schema versions, executedAssertionIds, phase/request/expected/actual or bounded raw diagnostics and cleanup. Store/cleanup failure prevents PASS. Return {verdict,evidenceRefs}; any caching requires all immutable identities and ownership, never prior-candidate results. For failure, retain the fixed-fixture single-request/single-row reduced reproducer specified in testContract, before owned cleanup; unrelated data is excluded. This is deterministic fixture reduction, not a generic minimization algorithm.
profileContract.composition: Direct module import supplies criterionVerifier to createProductQaExecutionStrategy. The adapter has evidenceStore access only, no QualityAcceptance publisher. Product QA runtimeObserver independently checks release identity; local preview identity alone is insufficient. No manifest field or automatic CLI invocation is added in BB-133.

testContract.matrix: For each N1-N13 construct the actual factory, call verify with pinned external profile and use fresh owned SQLite/store/service fixtures. N1 deleted rows, N2 weakened candidate schema, N3 required-input addition, N4 response removal, N5 corruption, N6 restart reset => FAIL with observed first differing assertion. N7 digest drift/N8 missing/no-op mandatory assertions/N9 identity missing => INCONCLUSIVE before effects or acceptance; N10 migration/setup and N11 timeout/parse => INCONCLUSIVE with bounded diagnostics. N12 foreign resources survive; N13 unknown/skipped criteria cannot PASS. Positive control must execute every mandatory old/new/migration/restart assertion and PASS.
testContract.reproducer: For an observed HTTP/assertion mismatch retain exactly the failing finite request method/path/body, expected/actual status/body projection and the single seed row involved, plus candidate/config/evaluator/preview/store/schema identities. This deterministic reduction of the fixed fixture is the minimized reproducer; unrelated requests/rows are excluded. Setup failures retain minimal setup diagnostics, not an invented HTTP mismatch. Retain before cleanup, within profile budgets.
testContract.composition: Focused suite injects actual createApiStateVerifier into createProductQaExecutionStrategy with existing parseable snapshot/component/order fixtures and independent runtimeObserver. Demonstrate adapter FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE cannot publish QualityAcceptance, and release drift is rejected independently. Existing qa-authority run supplies generic regression coverage; focused owns new adapter-specific corruption cases.
testContract.prototypeBoundary: The 13-case executed prototype uses synthetic candidate hashes/proposed shims and has non-minimized first-failure examples; it proves HTTP/SQLite discriminating feasibility only. Product-level exact Git/QA identities, durable evidenceStore and deterministic reduction are mandatory new focused tests, not existing generic QA coverage.
